import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_84/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_84/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_84/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_84/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_84/training_4.csv",
]

# Read all source files with index_col=0 to ignore the first numeric index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all source dataframes (UNION)
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The intermediate_step1.csv is the union of all sources, schema:
# ['Unnamed: 1', 'age_grp', 'Count', 'Notes', 'Rate', 'Statistics']

# We need to produce Target4_84 with schema:
# ['age_grp': string, 'Count': float, 'Notes': string, 'Rate': float, 'Statistics': string]

# Drop the 'Unnamed: 1' column as it is not part of the target schema
df_all = df_all.drop(columns=['Unnamed: 1'])

# Ensure columns have correct types and names as per target schema
# age_grp: string
df_all['age_grp'] = df_all['age_grp'].astype(str)

# Count: float (some may be NaN, keep as float)
df_all['Count'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['Count'], errors='coerce')

# Notes: string (may have NaN)
df_all['Notes'] = df_all['Notes'].astype('string')

# Rate: float
df_all['Rate'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['Rate'], errors='coerce')

# Statistics: string (may have NaN)
df_all['Statistics'] = df_all['Statistics'].astype('string')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_all = df_all[['age_grp', 'Count', 'Notes', 'Rate', 'Statistics']]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV path
df_all.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_84/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
